# Hiring Funnel Health - September 2026

**Author:** Priya N. (recruiting). Reviewed with Maya Chen Oct 2 and Nadia Okafor Oct 6.
**Covers:** Jun 1 to Sep 30, with year-to-date offer data. Previous review: Hiring Funnel Health - May 2026.

## Summary

The funnel is bigger than in May and the bar is holding. The problem is the last step: we lose too many offers. Engineering offer-accept year to date is 55%. Every senior iOS decline this year cited comp.

## Recruiting changes since May

- I joined in June as the 3-month contract recruiter; converted to full-time Sep 1.
- Referral bonus live since June 1: 19 referrals, 6 onsites, 1 hire (Theo Brandt).
- Hollis Partners running the VP Engineering search since Aug 25 (separate tracker; see VP Eng Decision Matrix).

## Open roles (as of Sep 30)

| Role | Hiring manager | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Senior iOS Engineer | Nadia Okafor | Final candidate (Ama), offer pending comp approval |
| Senior Backend Engineer, payments | Marcus Bell | 2 onsites scheduled for October |
| SRE | Maya Chen (interim) | Sourcing |
| VP Engineering | Maya Chen | Two finalists (Hollis) |

The other roles in Hiring Plan - Post Series B open after close.

## Funnel, Jun 1 to Sep 30

| Stage | Senior backend | Senior iOS | Junior/mid iOS |
|---|---|---|---|
| Applications | 162 | 71 | 140 |
| Recruiter screens | 41 | 19 | 22 |
| HM screens | 18 | 9 | 8 |
| Onsites | 7 | 4 | 3 |
| Offers | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Accepted | 1 (Sarah Kim) | 0 | 1 (Theo Brandt) |

Application volume per month is roughly 3x May, mostly from active sourcing and the revised Senior iOS Engineer JD.

## Offers, year to date (engineering)

| | Count |
|---|---|
| Offers extended | 11 |
| Accepted | 6 |
| Declined | 5 |
| Accept rate | 55% |

Accepted: three in Q1, plus Sam Whitfield (Jun 9 start), Sarah Kim (Jul 7), Theo Brandt (Aug 18).

Declines:
- Senior iOS, March: comp (competing offer $40k higher base)
- Senior backend, April: comp
- Senior iOS, August: comp, plus "investing launch risk"
- Data scientist, July: accepted counter-offer
- SRE, September: wanted fully remote outside our time zones

Three of five declines were comp. Two of those were senior iOS.

## What's wrong

Risk: Senior iOS bands are below market. Our band is $185-235k base. The two senior iOS candidates who declined had offers at $240k and $255k. Ama's expectations sit at the top of our band.

Risk: We lose candidates in the gap between final round and offer. Median 9 days. Candidates with other processes don't wait.

Risk: If accept rate stays at 55%, the 12-hire plan needs about 22 offers in 9 months. That's more onsites than our interviewers can absorb without a VP Eng and an EM.

## Recommendations

1. Move senior iOS band to $205-255k now, not after close (cost and proposal are in Budget 2027 - Engineering Headcount).
2. Offer within 3 business days of final round. Pre-approve comp ranges per role so hiring managers don't wait on Aleks for every offer.
3. Add a second interviewer pool for iOS (Nadia is in every loop and is also managing Theo).

Decision: Offer turnaround target is 3 business days from final round to written offer (Maya, Oct 2).

Open question: Who approves offers above band once a VP Eng starts, the VP Eng or Maya?

## Action items

- [ ] Nadia: get comp approval and extend senior iOS offer to Ama by 2026-10-10
- [ ] Priya N.: complete Grace Liu references by 2026-10-13
- [ ] Priya N.: pre-approved comp ranges per open role to Maya by 2026-10-16
- [ ] Nadia: train two more iOS interviewers by 2026-10-23
- [x] Priya N.: September funnel data pulled by 2026-10-01
